scope: Independent static review of the fixed pilot verifier, stored proof, rsync log, and final removal script. Removal was not executed by this reviewer; no payload hashes were repeated.
resolved_findings: Final script rechecks the external mount, archive directory, and exact archive metadata inventory immediately before deleting the quarantine.
Final readback requires the source symlink to resolve to an existing directory and uses strict path resolution on both sides.
reasoning: The verifier reads every regular file from each tree, compares full SHA256, and requires unchanged per-tree inode, device, size, mtime, ctime, link count and block metadata before and after. The proof contains all 11 file hashes and both matching path inventories.
Removal revalidates both inventories before staging. All regular files in the proof have one hard link, so no known alternate local hard-link consumer is hidden by the path inventory.

The exact source is renamed to a fixed sibling quarantine; the original path becomes an external archive symlink. Only the quarantine is passed to rmtree. Symlink creation failure attempts rollback; failed subsequent inventory or mount checks preserve quarantine without deletion.
The post-rename source inventory check preserves descendant identity. A later rmtree failure can leave a partially removed quarantine while the verified external copy remains the recovery source.

The rsync log reports 11 regular files totaling 1374992965 bytes, already copied with zero transfer bytes; parent observed successful process exit. The independent full-content proof is stronger evidence of equality than the transfer summary alone.
execution_conditions_and_limits: Execute the reviewed script with normal Python assertion checks enabled, without -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE; the code uses assertions as its safety gates.

This is a single-owner fixed-path retirement, not a general concurrent archive collector. It does not lock out future users or mutations; retain the parent-confirmed absence of live pilot consumers and avoid concurrent edits.

The process check examines host /proc cwd and open-fd path targets. It skips inaccessible processes and does not prove absence of mmap-only or future readers. Parent live-job/config inspection supplies additional scope evidence.
External availability can change after any pre-deletion check. Access through the preserved source symlink requires /mnt/e to remain mounted; the archive is the surviving copy.
No deletion or process changes were performed by this reviewer. The review does not authorize retirement of any other salvage directory.
